purpose: Qualify the remaining mastered-music, licence, excerpt and physical-playback gates without opening audio, assigning perceptual truth, contacting participants or authorizing stimulus generation.

current_primary_source_observations.format: original master-quality stereo WAV, 44.1 kHz signed-16 PCM
current_primary_source_observations.scope: 328 tracks across popular, genre, jazz, classical and royalty-free subcollections
current_primary_source_observations.grouping: 85 eligible artist families after existing exclusions and identity merges
current_primary_source_observations.independence_limit: one provider stratum; artist families do not prove disjoint sessions, engineers, studios or backing personnel

current_primary_source_observations.format: uncompressed stereo WAV, 44.1-48 kHz signed-16 PCM
current_primary_source_observations.scope: 1276 classical piano performances from ten competition years
current_primary_source_observations.grouping: co-locate the same composition across performances; exclude every previously consumed member and related composition
current_primary_source_observations.independence_limit: high-fidelity acoustic-performance domain, not mastered multi-genre production

current_primary_source_observations.format: 44.1 kHz signed-16 FLAC mixtures and multitracks; mixtures are mono
current_primary_source_observations.scope: 18 full-length electronic pieces, 61 minutes, with documented mix processing
current_primary_source_observations.grouping: one artist/provider family; every related mixture, stem and version co-located
current_primary_source_observations.independence_limit: one artist and mono mixtures; useful production-domain breadth but not stereo or artist transfer

deferred_or_excluded_sources.reason: 330 PCM WAV recordings span three named origins, but the record has no dataset-level licence field; item provenance, exact licence and prior-lossy lineage require audit before use
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 audio requires access request and the provider asks for consent before republishing any part
distributed reference audio is MP3 encoded and per-track licences vary; it cannot be a clean lossless codec-generation reference
the bound Zenodo release contains metadata while audio is obtained from Jamendo under per-track Creative Commons terms; clean lossless source lineage is not established
prior LossyTrace transfer work consumed this provider and it cannot become fresh listening or final-validation evidence

claim_boundary.future_narrow_claim_candidate: professional RWC mastered productions plus separately grouped high-fidelity piano and electronic-production calibration strata

local_playback_observation.observation_method: macOS system audio inventory and current-default-output query

human_decisions_required: Responsible human chooses either the narrower CC BY/CC0-only one-provider ODAQ fallback or the wider NC/SA source track; this choice determines the supportable source-breadth claim.

For the wider track, the responsible human confirms noncommercial status and ShareAlike delivery obligations; for the fallback, the responsible human accepts its one-provider development-only limit and the bound attribution notices.

Operator declares a stable headphone or calibrated loudspeaker chain, including DAC/amplifier, transducer model, quiet-room or ambient-noise class, system-effects state and conservative level-calibration method.
Operator performs the frozen channel and calibration checks without submitting degradation ratings or participant data.
authorized_next_step: Obtain the responsible-human source-track choice and a declared physical playback chain. The narrow CC BY/CC0 fallback now has exact reference metadata and a synthetic-verified fail-closed extractor, but remains one-provider development evidence and is not authorized for live acquisition. Do not access audio, select excerpts by listening, generate stimuli, execute metrics, contact participants or collect responses.
